archetypes.name: dyn-payload-normalization
archetypes.rationale: Parser normalization now conditionally drops guideline prose for marked entries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the architectural guideline parser changes for byte-stable behavior. Verify marked entries emit exactly the normalized heading plus Mechanized line, while unmarked entries preserve the prior Why and Deviate-only output. Check edge cases around non-guideline headings and marker bullets outside G-* entries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
